test_cases.name: Verbose quote request for bakery equipment and supplies
test_cases.description: A verbose customer requests a quote for several items, providing detailed context and explanations. The request includes multiple catalog items and additional information about their intended use. The customer uses neutral business language and includes extra context about their bakery's needs.

initial_turn.subject: Request for Quote: Equipment and Supplies for German Bakery
initial_turn.body:
Dear Sales Team,

I am reaching out on behalf of German Bakery as we are preparing for an upcoming expansion and need to source several items. To ensure we have everything ready for our new branch, I would appreciate a detailed quote for the following products:

- Rasta Coffee Grinder: We are looking to upgrade our coffee preparation area, so please include this item in the quote.
- WonderWash Washing Machine: This will be used for cleaning staff uniforms and linens, so please quote accordingly.
- Pizza: We plan to add pizza to our menu, but I am not sure which variant or size would be most suitable for a bakery setting. Please provide options or clarify what is available.
- Rug: We need a rug for the entrance area, but I noticed there are several types listed. Could you specify the differences and quote for the most durable option?

If you require any additional information about our requirements or the intended use of these items, please let me know. We are looking for competitive pricing and reliable delivery timelines, as our opening date is approaching.

Best regards,
Jakob Kuhs

test_cases.name: Verbose Quote Request for Multiple Apparel Items
test_cases.description: A verbose and polite customer from Lanesra Merchs Inc. requests a quote for several apparel items, providing detailed context and explanations. The request includes an ambiguous line item that will require clarification from the SOA before a quote can be created.

initial_turn.subject: Request for Detailed Quote on Apparel Items
initial_turn.body:
Dear Sales Team,

I hope this message finds you well. My name is Jordan, and I am reaching out on behalf of Lanesra Merchs Inc. as we are currently evaluating new suppliers for our upcoming promotional campaign. We are particularly interested in expanding our apparel offerings and would like to request a formal quote for several items from your catalog. To ensure we have all the necessary information for our internal review, please include pricing, lead times, and any available bulk order discounts.

Here is the list of items we are considering:

- T-Shirt (we noticed there are several T-Shirts listed, but we are interested in the standard one; could you please quote for this?)
- Generic Jeans (quantity: 50)
- Generic Golden T-Shirt (quantity: 30)

If you require any additional details to provide an accurate quote, please let us know. We appreciate your assistance and look forward to your prompt response.

Best regards,
Lanesra Merchs Inc.

test_cases.name: Verbose quote request for multiple items
test_cases.description: Sarah Johnson requests a quote for several items, providing extra context and explanations in an informal, verbose style. The request is clear and detailed, setting up for a later quote rejection.

initial_turn.subject: Quote Request for Toys, Rug, and Soda
initial_turn.body:
Hi there,

I hope you’re having a good day! I’m reaching out because I’d like to get a quote for a few items for our upcoming community event. We’re planning some activities for kids and refreshments for the guests, so I want to make sure we cover all bases. Here’s what I’m looking for:

- 2 sets of AdventureCraft Building Blocks (these are for the play area, so durability is important)
- 1 Rug (I noticed you have a few options listed, but I’m not sure which would be best for a high-traffic kids’ zone—could you include the details or recommend one?)
- 24 bottles of Soda - Medium (for the refreshment stand)

If you need any more info about the event or the intended use, just let me know. Please send me a quote with pricing and availability when you get a chance. Thanks so much!

Best,
Sarah Johnson

Best regards,
Sarah Johnson

Lanesra Merchs Inc.

Best regards,
Lanesra Merchs Inc.
